notes.title: New patch update!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Thank you for playing Class of Heroes 2G: Remaster Edition and sharing your feedback with us.
A new patch has now been released, addressing the below issues: 

・Fixed a bug in which certain actions caused party members on standby to be replaced by a Level 0 character
・Fixed a bug in which BGM volume settings were not saved
・Fixed misaligned translations on command menu at Bruschetta dorm
・Fixed a bug in which certain trophies and titles were not unlocking
・Added voice volume adjustment option
・Fixed erroneous recipes

Keep adventuring!
